title: Compass Unveils ‘See It First™’ in Its Biggest Compass.com Redesign in a Decade, Giving Buyers Early Access to More Homes

body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, NY – September 22, 2026** — Compass introduces ‘See It First™’ as part of the biggest redesign of Compass.com in a decade, giving consumers earlier access to more homes. By bringing together thousands of homes across every stage of marketing from Compass International Holdings’ nine powerhouse brands in one destination, See It First™ gives buyers greater selection and an elevated search experience while empowering sellers to gauge demand and build buyer interest without accruing public days on market or public price changes.


“With See It First™, we’re giving consumers the opportunity to discover more homes earlier,” said Julie Keef, Compass Head of Consumer Search. “By bringing more homes and local expertise together in one place, we’re making Compass.com an even more valuable destination for buyers to start and continue their home search.”


Every element of Compass.com has been redesigned to make it easier for more buyers to discover more homes, earlier, with See It First™ integrated throughout the search experience. The redesigned homepage, search experience, and listing pages, along with new See It First™ badges and a dedicated landing page, help all buyers identify and explore homes earlier.


**Why See It First™:**


-


**All buyers can discover more homes.** See It First™ brings more homes together in one place, giving all buyers more opportunities to find the right home on Compass.com. Any buyer or buyer’s agent, regardless of brokerage affiliation, can learn more about any home represented by a real estate professional affiliated with any of the nine Compass International Holdings brands. Buyers do not need to work with a Compass real estate professional to view these listings.


-


**Sellers can test the market with confidence.** See It First™ empowers homeowners to test pricing and build buyer demand through premium placement in search results, without accruing days on market or public price drops. Sellers can then use those insights to adjust their pricing and marketing strategy. For sellers who want to sell but are not fully committed, or who want to put their home on the market off-season, See It First™ gives them the opportunity to test the market first, without risk.


-


**Real estate professionals have more ways to compete for clients and deliver value.** Real estate professionals compete every day to win clients, and See It First™ gives them more ways to deliver value and choice to prospective clients. Because the listing agent remains front and center, with their name, photo, and brokerage prominently displayed on every home they represent, buyers and their brokers can get answers directly from the real estate professional who knows the home best, while sellers know the interest their home generates is going directly to the agent they chose to represent them.


Traffic to Compass.com grew 56% year-over-year in August 2026, as more consumers turned to the platform to search for their next home. Building on that momentum, Compass is making a multimillion-dollar investment in a nationwide advertising campaign to introduce See It First™ and the elevated consumer search experience on Compass.com. Together, the redesign and campaign strengthen Compass.com as a destination where consumers can discover more homes earlier.


The See It First™ launch comes as recent research highlights the value of strategic marketing. An analysis of Compass-sold homes nationwide during the 12-month period ending March 31, 2026, found that homes strategically marketed sold faster.


Visit[compass.com](http://compass.com/) to learn more and discover thousands of See It First™ listings.


About Compass


Compass is a leading tech-enabled real estate services company that includes the largest residential real estate brokerage in the United States by sales volume. Founded in 2012 and based in New York City, Compass provides an end-to-end platform that empowers its residential real estate agents at its owned-brokerage to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients. The platform includes an integrated suite of cloud-based software for customer relationship management, marketing, client service, brokerage services, and other critical functionality, all custom-built for the real estate industry. Compass agents utilize the platform to grow their business, save time, and manage their business more efficiently. The Compass network includes Christie's International Real Estate, the world's premier global luxury real estate brand with over 100 independently owned brokerage Affiliates in 50 countries and territories. For more information on how Compass empowers real estate agents, one of the largest groups of small business owners, please visit[www.compass.com](https://www.compass.com/) .
